A DeepSeek Harness plugin that exports **your own** Douyin and Xiaohongshu web favorites into Markdo
wn (topic groups + optional LLM digest). It reuses a logged-in Playwright / Chrome session. Do not u
se it on anyone else's account.
## Compliance — read first
This is a **personal backup tool**, not a scraper service. Keep it that way:
- **Your own account, your own data.** Export only favorites from an account you logged into yoursel

f (QR scan). Never point it at other people's accounts or data.
- **Respect the platforms.** Automat
ed access may violate Douyin / Xiaohongshu terms of service even for your own data. Risk control may
throttle or ban your account — that risk is yours; the tool works from your own logged-in session a

nd solves no captchas for you.
- **No commercial use, no redistribution.** Exported content belongs
to its original authors. Keep outputs for personal reference; do not resell, republish, or bulk-redi

stribute them.
- **Nothing leaves your machine.** Collection, artifacts, and digests all run and sta

hem.
- **Nothing leaves your machine.** Collection, artifacts, and digests all run and stay locally.
## Install
Requires Node.js 20 or 22 and a Harness profile that mounts the `commands` and `sessionQuery` servic
es (the official `web` / `agent` profiles do).

ile is stored at `~/.dsh/favorites-digest/profile`.

| `/favorites login` | Open Douyin + Xiaohongshu and wait until the web session is logged in |
| `/f

avorites` / `/favorites run` | Collect + write Markdown/JSON (LLM digest if an API key is set) |

digest` | Rebuild Markdown from the latest JSON in the output dir |

| `/favorites --limit 50` | Cap per site (debug) |
| `/favorites --likes` | Also

export Douyin 喜欢 |

hrome |

| `/favorites --out /path` | Output dire

Same as other `ctx.commands` handlers: results stay off the model transcript (zero tokens).
## Optional model tool
Off by default. Set `exposeTool: true` on the plugin row to register `favorites_digest` for the agen
f by default. Set `exposeTool: true` on the plugin row to register `favorites_digest` for the agent.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

## Optional LLM digest
If `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` is set, `/favorites run` appends an
AI 综述 section. Compatible OpenAI-style bases work via `OPENAI_BASE_URL` / `OPENAI_MODEL`. Topic gro
uping still works with no key.

## Open-source project identification
`run`/`digest` also scan titles and descriptions for open-sour
ce projects — explicit `github.com/<owner>/<repo>` links plus dashed/camelCase names like `open-code
-review` or `Windows-MCP` — and verify them against the GitHub search API, so the Markdown gains a 开
源项目 section with repo, star count and which favorite mentioned it. Anonymous GitHub search is rate-l
imited (10 req/min), so at most 8 candidates are checked with spacing and the step degrades silently
on 403. Set `identifyProjects: false` to turn it off; `digest` re-renders the stored list without r
t `identifyProjects: false` to turn it off; `digest` re-renders the stored list without re-querying.
## How collection works
1. Open the logged-in 收藏 surfaces (Xiaohongshu profile → 收藏 → 笔记; Douyin `/user/self?showTab=favorit

e_collection`).
2. Listen to the page's own list JSON **and** scrape visible cards.
3. Scroll until
the count stops growing.
Site redesigns can break selectors. Captchas must be solved in the opened window.
## Troubleshooting
- **`collect` aborts with 未登录** — login detection uses hard signals (Douyin `sessionid` cookie; Xiao
hongshu avatar-vs-`登录`-button probe). An abort means the session really is not logged in: re-run `/f
avorites login` and scan both QR codes; it only reports success after both platforms are confirmed.
- **Xiaohongshu shows “IP 存在风险” (error 300012) during login** — XHS risk control can block QR login
from automated browsers on some networks. Log in inside a Chrome you launched yourself, then attach:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Chrome ≥136 refuses `--remote-debugging-port` on the default profile, so the dedicated `--user-data-

dir` is required.
- **CDP attach fails with “Browser context management is not supported”** — Chrome
154 removed the browser-level CDP calls older Playwright issued at attach time; requires `playwrigh

t` ≥ 1.64.
- **Why hard-fail when not logged in?** Logged-out collection used to silently export the

recommendation feed as your “favorites”. It now aborts instead of fabricating data.
- **Running the
TS sources with Node type stripping fails** (`parameter property is not supported in strip-only mod
e`) — expected; the sources target the bundler. Use `npm run bundle` output (`lib/`), which is what
the published plugin runs.
